text:
jamie: Quick note - tried the JS SDK quickstart on Deno and Bun for a partner POC, ran into multiple runtime issues.
owen: what errors did you see?
jamie: Deno -> `Uncaught Error: package.json exports do not contain ./deno` when doing `import Redwood from 'redwood'`. TS also flagged no default export.
dina: that's because our README uses a Node-style default import. Deno prefers named ESM exports or an explicit deno entrypoint.
sam: agreed. We should add a `./deno` export and publish an ESM-only deno bundle. Example exports config: ```json {"exports":{"./deno":"./dist/deno/index.mjs",".":{"import":"./dist/esm/index.mjs","require":"./dist/cjs/index.js"}} } ```
jamie: nice. Also Bun 0.xx had flaky `crypto.subtle` and slightly different fetch body shapes; the auth signing blew up intermittently.
owen: for crypto, a tiny runtime shim that checks `globalThis.crypto?.subtle` and falls back to a small JS implementation (or dynamic import of a lightweight secp helper) would be fine. Make it opt-in so Node builds remain small.
dina: fetch differences too - Bun's response.body stream shape didn't match our `instanceof ReadableStream` checks. Quick robust parser: try `response.json()` then fallback to `response.arrayBuffer()` + decode.
sam: let's centralize into runtime-adapters: isDeno/isBun/isNode + helpers: fetchNormalize, subtlePolyfill, streamToBuffer. Keep it tree-shakeable.
jamie: I'll open a PR adding `dist/deno/index.mjs` + `dist/deno/index.d.ts` and an `examples/deno-quickstart` with deno.json + import_map.json. README will show `import { Redwood } from 'redwood/deno'` and `const c = new Redwood({ apiKey: Deno.env.get('REDWOOD_KEY') });`
owen: add a small CI matrix job: node 18/20, deno 1.34/1.35, bun nightly to run the sample apps. ci-bot: nightly deno job failed - https://ci.internal/tx/987 (shows exports resolve error)
sam: i'll own the subtle fallback + runtime-adapters tests (simulate missing subtle in unit tests).
dina: i'll update the SDK README with compatibility table and a troubleshooting section: "If you see `exports do not contain ./deno`, try `import { Redwood } from 'redwood/deno'` or upgrade to SDK >= x.y.z"
jamie: thanks. Partner POC is on Thursday so will prioritize. I'll link PR when ready.
ci-bot: created issue #619: "JS SDK: Deno/Bun compatibility - deno export, runtime adapters, webcrypto fallback, fetch normalization" assigned to jamie,sam,dina.
jamie: will also add a tiny note to devex checklist so quickstarts avoid Node-only import examples.
